root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: bucket < GDBM_DIR_COUNT (dbf) before any dbf->dir[bucket] dereference
root_cause_criterion.criterion: After _gdbm_hash_key (dbf, key, &hash, &bucket, &offset) returns in gdbm_valid_key_p, the recomputed directory index bucket must remain within the materialized directory extent before the function may read dbf->dir[bucket]. For the staged witness, bucket is already outside the 32-entry directory while the vulnerable original still proceeds to the directory comparison once the hash-equality conjunct succeeds.
root_cause_criterion.description: The missing source-level obligation at the root-cause condition is that the recomputed bucket index must satisfy the same directory-bound check that _gdbm_get_bucket enforces before reusing it as dbf->dir[bucket].
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original trace records key_verify_guard.bucket=47 and key_verify_guard.dir_count=32 while the protected dir_index_read event executes, so the required predicate is violated at the root-cause site. The fixed original records the same 47/32 root values but no protected event (guarded). The adjacent boundary witness dir_size_256_dir_bits_5_boundary executes the protected event on both sides with bucket=23 and dir_count=32, providing the genuine fixed-side witness for the same source-level obligation.

nodes.description: At the second conjunct that dereferences dbf->dir[bucket], the vulnerable execution uses a bucket index that is already outside GDBM_DIR_COUNT (dbf), so evaluating the comparison reads past the 32-entry in-memory directory array.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records dir_index_read.bucket=47 and dir_index_read.dir_count=32, so the protected read executes with 47 >= 32.

edges.relation: The same recomputed bucket value that violates the missing directory-bound obligation at the root-cause condition is carried unchanged into the immediately following dbf->dir[bucket] read.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records key_verify_guard.bucket == dir_index_read.bucket == 47.
